name: academic-students
description: Skills for university students in any degree, in Hebrew and English: break down and check assignments, split group work, estimate the grade an expert professor would give, academic writing with real citations, exam prep from past exams, lecture summaries, a study planner, a read-only Moodle sync, and a prompt-injection scanner that checks every course file before Claude works on it. Never submits, never answers quizzes, never stores a password.
